definitions.explanation: A conference attended by participants from multiple countries — used for academic, business, diplomatic, and intergovernmental meetings alike.

examples.japanese: {国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
{気候変動|きこうへんどう}に{関|かん}する{国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An international conference on climate change was held.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}で{研究|けんきゅう}{成果|せいか}を{発表|はっぴょう}するために{渡米|とべい}した。
examples.english: He flew to the U.S. to present his research findings at an international conference.

notes:
Compound of {国際|こくさい} (international) + {会議|かいぎ} (conference/meeting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an international conference
- {国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}に{参加|さんか}する: to take part in an international conference
- {国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}{場|じょう}: international conference venue
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}: international academic conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {首脳|しゅのう}{会議|かいぎ}: summit (of heads of state)
- シンポジウム: symposium — typically smaller and more topic-focused
- {学会|がっかい}: academic conference / learned society
